partial.description:
Partial is set when at least one path walk hit the request deadline,
so the counts are lower bounds.

category.description:
Category is the Newznab category ID from the indexer (e.g. "3010" for MP3, "3040" for Lossless).
Used as a fallback to infer audio format when none is present in the release title.

search_for.description: Complete search query (e.g., "Album Title Artist Name" for music)

absolute_episode.description: AbsoluteEpisode is the absolute episode number (for anime and shows with continuous numbering)

albumid.description: AlbumID is the application ID of the music album

artist.description: Artist is the artist name for music

asin.description: ASIN is the Amazon ASIN identifier for audiobooks

audio_bit_depth.description: AudioBitDepth is the bit depth (16, 24, 32) for lossless audio

audio_bitrate.description: AudioBitrate is the audio bitrate in kbps for music/audiobooks

audio_format.description: AudioFormat is the audio codec/format (mp3, flac, aac, etc.) for music/audiobooks

audio_format_id.description: AudioFormatID is the database ID for the audio format

audio_sample_rate.description: AudioSampleRate is the sample rate in Hz for music/audiobooks

audiobookid.description: AudiobookID is the application ID of the audiobook

audioid.description: AudioID is the database ID of the audio

bookid.description: BookID is the application ID of the book

codecid.description: CodecID is the database ID of the codec

dbalbumid.description: DbalbumID is the database ID of the music album

dbaudiobookid.description: DbaudiobookID is the database ID of the audiobook

dbbookid.description: DbbookID is the database ID of the book

dbmovieid.description: DbmovieID is the database ID of the movie

dbserieepisodeid.description: DbserieEpisodeID is the database ID of the episode

dbserieid.description: DbserieID is the database ID of the TV series

episode.description: Episode is the episode number, if applicable

episodestr.description: EpisodeStr is the episode number as a string, if applicable

extended.description: Extended is a flag indicating if it is an extended version

file.description: File is the path to the media file

height.description: Height is the video height in pixels

isbn.description: ISBN is the ISBN-13 or ISBN-10 identifier for books

languages.description: Languages is a list of language codes

listID.description: ListID is the ID of the list this came from

movieid.description: MovieID is the application ID of the movie

musicbrainz_id.description: MusicBrainzID is the MusicBrainz release ID for music

priority.description: Priority is the priority for downloading

proper.description: Proper is a flag indicating if it is a proper release

quality.description: Quality is the video quality description

qualityid.description: QualityID is the database ID of the quality

repack.description: Repack is a flag indicating if it is a repack release

resolutionid.description: ResolutionID is the database ID of the resolution

retail.description: Retail is a flag indicating a retail ebook release (books only)

runtime.description: Runtime is the runtime in minutes

season.description: Season is the season number, if applicable

seasonstr.description: SeasonStr is the season number as a string, if applicable

serieepisodeid.description: SerieEpisodeID is the application ID of the episode

serieid.description: SerieID is the application ID of the TV series

title.description: Title is the title of the media

upc.description: UPC is the Universal Product Code for music

width.description: Width is the video width in pixels

year.description: Year is the year of release

queue.description: worker queue; selects the cron instance on removal
